title: Odyssey THEMIS filename
reference: Mars Odyssey THEMIS Standard Data Products SIS, §3.1

segments.label: Orbit
segments.description: Mission orbit number when the image was collected.

patterns.meaning: Mapping orbit past 100,000 — the leading letter carries the sixth digit (A = 10, B = 11, C = 12, and so on)

segments.label: Sequence
segments.description: Order in which images were collected during that orbit.

segments.label: Processing level
segments.description: Processing level of the image data. Codes outside the SIS list appear in the archive for reprojected renditions.

EDR.description: Uncompressed band-sequential 8-bit qube as collected: up to 10 bands for IR, 5 for VIS.

RDR.description: Same geometry as the source EDR, with calibrated values scaled into 16-bit integers.

BTR.description: Single-band 8-bit image of brightness temperature, the same size as one band of the source IR RDR.

ABR.description: Single-band 8-bit image of apparent brightness, the same size as one band of the source VIS RDR.

BWS.description: Browse rendition of the observation; the SIS lists it among the PDS4 collections rather than the standard product types.

values.CUB.GZ: Gzipped ISIS cube — a reprojected rendition distributed in the archive, outside the SIS standard product formats
